cluster_definitions.name: SECTION_AND_AREA_COMPOUND_QUESTION_GROUNDING
cluster_definitions.root_cause: In all 24 positive section_and_area problems, the cutting-plane definition sentence and the compound question sentence ('Hãy xác định thiết diện tạo bởi mặt phẳng (P) với hình ... và tính diện tích của thiết diện đó') are separate sentences. When derived_section.source.quote points to the question sentence, kiem_nguon rejects it with SOURCE_OBJECT_MISMATCH because the question sentence refers to plane (P) by name without repeating its through_point and parallel/perpendicular relation.

cluster_definitions.name: DIVIDE_SEGMENT_AND_PROJECTION_KEYWORD_LEXICON
cluster_definitions.root_cause: 10 cases use standard Vietnamese ratio connectors 'thỏa mãn' or 'với' instead of literal 'sao cho' for divide_segment; 4 oblique_triangular_prism cases state the altitude foot as 'chân đường cao kẻ/hạ từ ... đến/xuống mặt phẳng ... là ...' instead of literal 'hình chiếu'.

cluster_definitions.name: PARALLEL_TWO_LINES_SLICE_GRAMMAR_COVERAGE
cluster_definitions.root_cause: The full-text slice check on parallel_two_lines requires every premise quote and plane clause to match a narrow set of clause templates; multi-clause premise sentences or 'đồng thời song song với hai đường thẳng' trigger SOURCE_PREMISE_UNREAD.

cluster_definitions.name: CUBE_BASE_SQUARE_EDGE_LENGTH_BINDING
cluster_definitions.root_cause: When a cube problem states the edge length via its base square ('biết mặt đáy MNPQ là hình vuông có cạnh bằng 9a'), kiem_nguon does not bind that value to segment_length(M, N) without 'hình lập phương ... có cạnh bằng' or 'MN = 9a'.

cluster_definitions.name: GIA_SU_PREMISE_OPENER_CONDITIONAL_FALSE_POSITIVE
cluster_definitions.root_cause: W3-B01 introduces the point ratio with 'Giả sử H là điểm thuộc cạnh bên SE...' and the derived_section quote spans across that sentence, triggering the substring guard for 'giả sử' (CONDITIONAL_CLAUSE).
